claim.quote: we report the first ionization energy and 3D track observations of nuclear recoils produced by the radon progeny.

name: First detection of tracks of radon progeny recoils by MIMAC

summary.plain: In the Modane underground laboratory MIMAC recorded, for the first time, the energy and three-dimensional tracks of low-energy nuclear recoils from radon decay products, showing the detector can see recoil directions.
summary.technical: Bi-chamber prototype at LSM (2012 and 2013 data sets): first ionization energy and 3D track measurement of nuclear recoils from radon progeny.

title: First detection of tracks of radon progeny recoils by MIMAC
why_it_matters: The abstract says this shows the capability of the MIMAC detector and opens the possibility to explore the low-energy recoil directionality signature.
